mapper.update: UPDATE underwriting SET underwriter_emp_no = #{empNo}, underwriter_name = #{empName}, underwriter_dept = #{empDept}, total_score = #{uw.totalScore}, underwriting_status = #{uw.underwritingStatus}, underwriting_type = #{uw.underwritingType}, underwriting_result = #{uwResult}, rejection_reason = #{uw.deductionReason}, underwritten_at = #{uw.underwrittenAt} WHERE underwriting_id = #{underwritingId}
